content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

A bank bailout is very, very costly. For instance, the taxpayer stood in for the failed bank 'Hypo Real Estate' with a three-figure billion amount. That's why we should not allow any additional bank rescues. The politicians are trying to appease us with the fact that actually only a tiny amount of all that money was really spent. But even with that tiny amount you could do a lot of good elsewhere.
What is the relation between "That's why we should not allow any additional bank rescues." and "A bank bailout is very, very costly." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
